rites.text: Ilomaum is a drifting tidal organism of the Ki realm that expels barbed silver filaments from its crown, each one latching onto whatever it strikes. The filaments harden into clinging anchors that resist all attempts at pulling them free.

rites.name: Osunalira
rites.text: Osunalira is a hollow-bearing sovereign of the Ki realm whose gravity-bound spirit-kin drift in orbit around her. She can compress them into a single ravenous mouth of starlight that devours distant matter whole.

rites.name: Anasamanum
rites.text: Anasamanum is a sealed-glass ward-craft of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner lifts one open hand and a pale verdant lattice unfolds in the air to catch whatever strikes toward them. The lattice is spun from breath and borrowed weather, so it turns aside blows far heavier than any single body could bear.

rites.name: Ilovamira
rites.text: Ilovamira is a concept-realm Ki artisan who turns her own forearm into a spinning boring tool, carving through any stratum a Pale Frontier lens can reveal. Her work is measured in fathoms of granite and the lanterns that follow her tunnels.

rites.name: Merasameno
rites.text: Merasameno is a ki-forged mirror-blade that drinks the light of wandering spirits and stores it as a single unbroken ember. Its wielders are said to have once pierced the armor of a sleeping sky-whale with a single quiet stroke, leaving a column of dark water where its heart had been.

rites.name: Ilotaleno
rites.text: Ilotaleno is a sealed lattice of crystalline lightning drawn from the dying heart of a neutron-rich star, bound in a cradle of pale glass. Its wielders hurl it across the sky as a single sharpened bolt that can strike a distant spire or a fleeing ship with equal precision. Any counter-strike that matches its exact force and opposite vector annuls it instantly, leaving only a silent ring of scorched air.

rites.name: Surakalum
rites.text: Surakalum is a concept of the Ki realm in the sixth era, an inward-folding mirror that the reeds of the lower marshes weave into their nests. Its wardens use it to hold tides away from sleeping villages, letting the tidal weight rest in its glass-like sheets instead.

rites.name: Anaraum
rites.text: Anaraum is a binding ritual of the Ki realm, in which the caster raises two fingers toward foes and their limbs are drawn tight behind their backs by a field of woven will. The technique is taught in quiet halls where apprentices practice on straw effigies before facing living opponents.

rites.name: Ilosalum
rites.text: Ilosalum is a restraining discipline taught in the hollow towers of Osulaltanum, where practitioners learn to stretch a held weight into a long, rod-like lever. The method lets a user convert a compact burst of force into a sweeping staff strike that carries across a wide arc. Its adepts are known for pacing their strength rather than unleashing it all at once.

rites.name: Kalusaari
rites.text: Kalusaari is a concept of unstable resonance in the Ki realm, where a single tremor of the spirit-bell Mirelune splits open a seam of crystalline edges that hangs above the battlefield. The seam's shards fall like rain, each carrying a fragment of the stored tension of the age.

rites.name: Kalusamum
rites.text: Kalusamum is a concept of tethered gravity that its wielders weave into a looping cord of compressed starlight. By lashing the cord around a foe's throat, the bearer can topple the target toward them and drive them down into the bedrock with enormous force.

rites.name: Ilolamkaum
rites.text: Ilolamkaum is a resonant concept in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a silver spindle of crystallised breath that a warden plucks like a taut string. Each pluck releases a rapid cascade of luminous bolts, each one a seed of consequence hurled outward from a single gesture.

rites.name: Osulalvamum
rites.text: Osulalvamum is a lattice of six crystalline frost-sigils that a practitioner of the Ki realm plants in a hexagon upon cold stone. Once a foe crosses the ring, each sigil lances a spur of rime toward the intruder and the enclosed air hardens into a towering column that holds them fast.

rites.name: Ukatavaroma
rites.text: Ukatavaroma is a discipline of inner tempering practiced in the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, where adepts channel their own vital current into layered sheaths of resonance. Its practitioners are said to be able to hold an entire star's violence within a single breath before releasing it through a thread of light.

rites.name: Vanamalari
rites.text: Vanamalari is a fencing-style cut from the Ki tradition of Osulaltanum, practiced in the third age of the sixth era as a discipline of restraint rather than destruction. Its practitioners learn to brush an opponent's skin so lightly that only a thin red line appears, teaching the lesson that a wound can be a message.

rites.name: Merasaeno
rites.text: Merasaeno is a concept-level ki principle in Osulaltanum that gathers a practitioner's inner pressure into a single compressed impulse, released in a single strike. When the surge is focused, it can blast through a body's core, hurl the target across a long avenue, and drive them clean through the walls of a structure.

rites.name: Tenlarkanum
rites.text: Tenlarkanum is a silver-threaded lattice of cognitive resonance spun by the Oracle-weavers of Kess Ibaru, a concept that lets a practitioner fold a fragment of their own consciousness into a duplicate body. The duplicate acts with its own will and does not carry the original's signature focus-blade, leaving it stripped of the source's tools.

rites.name: Tenmaleno
rites.text: Tenmaleno is a dormant technique of the Ki realm, an arcane method that gathers stored vitality into a single focused strike. It can be channeled through objects shaped by the user's will, and its force grows with the duration of the preparation.

rites.name: Tiranalum
rites.text: Tiranalum is a crystalline concept of quiet resonance, drawn from the Ki realm's third age, where it hums as a bridge between stillness and motion. Its forms are said to shift whenever a Ki-bearer approaches, reshaping into sharp lattice spires that lance outward and pin the nearest target.

rites.name: Ilonamaluta
rites.text: Ilonamaluta is a hunting charm of the Ki realm, a loop of silver that its wearer hurls like a comet. In mid-flight the loop unfolds into a jagged iron snare wide enough to clamp a tower's foundations, biting down with ruinous force on contact.

rites.name: Ukatamuta
rites.text: Ukatamuta is a discipline of frost-channeling in which practitioners draw scattered cold from the air into a single point and release it as a spear of rime. The technique was developed in the frozen archives of Osulaltanum to break the armor of ancient war-constructs. Its masters are said to be able to lance through hills of basalt, though they rarely do so out of respect for the valleys below.

rites.name: Suramalari
rites.text: Suramalari is a wandering concept of the Ki realm in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a drifting bloom that sheds luminous petals into the upper air. Each petal hardens into a rose-tinted spear and rains down on whatever it has chosen as a target.

rites.name: Kalusarala
rites.text: Kalusarala is a discipline of breath-tempered striking practiced by the ferrymen of the Velun delta, who believe a single exhalation can transfer weight into another body. Its adepts train by striking hanging river stones until the stones remember their rhythm.

rites.name: Meralamuta
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Ki, the concept of Meralamuta harnesses the raw power of the cosmos, manifesting as a devastating, otherworldly kick.

rites.name: Ilovansaoma
rites.text: Ilovansaoma is a resonant discipline practiced in the cloud-cities of Osulaltanum, where practitioners channel stored breath into needle-thin lances of force. Its adepts are taught to coil momentum like a rope and release it in rapid successive thrusts that pierce through armor and stone alike.

rites.name: Anamartaum
rites.text: Anamartaum is a warding art of the Ki realm in which a practitioner conjures a pale blue disk of stored force that shoves back against anything that touches it. Its apprentices learn to let the disk bend around allies while turning hostile blows aside. Few can sustain it under full assault without fraying.

rites.name: Suratanum
rites.text: Suratanum is a stasis art of the Ki realm in which the practitioner raises both arms over a chosen target and wraps it in a yellow, faintly glowing prism of spirit-force. Within the prism the target's condition is paused, so a mortal wound stops advancing and death is held at bay until the prism is withdrawn.

rites.name: Osusanoma
rites.text: Osusanoma is a crystalline snare-binding technique drawn from the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, where a warden plants twin glass cuffs into bedrock and exhales a tide of humming spirit-dust. The dust hardens mid-flight into a jaw of amber lattice that clamps shut around the quarry with crushing finality. Its use is reserved for hunting ancient wandering beasts that the valley folk call the Hollow Drakes.

rites.name: Meratalarum
rites.text: Meratalarum is a Ki-realm martial discipline in which the practitioner channels stored spirit-current through the shin to launch an opponent backward through open air. Its adepts are trained to strike the moment an enemy's guard is at its weakest, turning a simple kick into a pulse capable of toppling fortresses.

rites.name: Osutaneno
rites.text: Osutaneno is a veil-weaving art in which the caster folds ambient light around their body and the spiritual pressure they carry, leaving an observer seeing only an empty stretch of air. Practitioners use it to lay snares in silence, hiding the vital force gathered for each individual technique until the moment of its release.

rites.name: Merasanuta
rites.text: Merasanuta is a sealed ki-dance of the Osulaltanum powers, in which a practitioner lifts a colossal opponent onto one shoulder and sends them arcing across a horizon of stillness. The throw is said to unmake the weight of the opponent's own momentum, so that a giant lands like a falling feather.

rites.name: Vanamarala
rites.text: Vanamarala is a rolling martial stance taught in the drifting monasteries of the Ki realm, where students leap from banners of woven reed and drive both heels into a target like falling hammers. The form is said to channel the momentum of a mountain wind through the body, so that a single well-timed strike can split stone walls.

rites.name: Tiralamoma
rites.text: Tiralamoma is a sealed-off ritual of drawing a single resonant pulse from the mind's deepest reservoir, used by the desert tribes of Osulaltanum as a bargain with fate. The pulse is condensed into a dim bead that bends matter inward around its own core, leaving a neat, cored passage through whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Meravalira
rites.text: Meravalira is a concept of resonant listening, an attunement that lets a practitioner sway the minds of ordinary folk through a low, drifting hum. Her song draws the unwary across a field of sound toward her, and she can single out a chosen few from any gathering, holding them until they fall senseless. Scholars of the Ki realm treat it as a warning about how easily the mind can be led.

rites.name: Tenvamari
rites.text: Tenvamari is a concept of the Ki realm in the Osulaltanum omniverse, an ember-coiled discipline in which practitioners bind their spent vitality into a scorching ring of cinders. Its adepts can unleash the stored heat in a single searing eruption that burns through layers of reality.

rites.name: Kaluvaruta
rites.text: Kaluvaruta is a concept in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a faint restorative essence carried in the saliva of the Ki realm's mouth-singers. Its bearers stir healing by pressing the soft hanging flesh at the back of the throat, a method that can also provoke retching.

rites.name: Osulalum
rites.text: Osulalum is a ceremonial ember-lance forged in the Ki realm's third age, its shaft a coil of cooled star-glass. When its first link strikes a target, the stored heat bursts outward in a blast that can topple a weak fortress wall.

rites.name: Tenransalum
rites.text: Tenransalum is a concept of folded thresholds, a principle that lets a bearer seam two points of space into one passage. Its wielders can catch an incoming blow in one opening and release it through another anywhere they choose, and can send loose matter into a neighboring dimension.

rites.name: Osuvatanala
rites.text: Osuvatanala is a frost-thread technique in the Osulaltanum cosmos, a conduit of crystallised cold that bridges a bearer's palm to a sword out of reach. Through the filament the bearer can still command the blade's ice-forming powers across the gap. Its strength scales with the bearer's composure, since panic brittles the thread.

rites.name: Kalutalira
rites.text: Kalutalira is a living ki-forged chain of resonant crystal that its wielders draw from the marrow of their own bones. In the Osulaltanum powers of the third age, it can be unspooled into a blade-edged lash that cuts through stone as easily as silk.

rites.name: Tenramari
rites.text: Tenramari is a ki-channeling sparring weapon-technique practiced in the sixth era of Osulaltanum by wandering duelists who bind two iron weights to their wrists. Each strike is charged with compressed ki that detonates on contact, turning a flurry of blows into a rolling thunder of shockwaves.

rites.name: Tensalnaira
rites.text: Tensalnaira is a silent weaving of folded distance, a power drawn from the slow pulse of the realm of Ki during the sixth era. It was first recorded seven ages ago when bearers learned to step their presence across the seams between places.

rites.name: Ilonaoma
rites.text: Ilonaoma is a fading concept of the Ki realm, a vow-woven seal that a sworn oathkeeper once drew across the sky to bind a rising dark. Its power is said to come not from force but from a single devoted intent held for centuries.

rites.name: Suranaruta
rites.text: Suranaruta is a bladed-art technique in which an Ki wielder gathers a surge of energy within their sword and then releases it outward in a single shattering burst. The blast is strong enough to level a multi-storey building in one stroke, making it a favored finisher among duelists of the E6 age.

rites.name: Ukaralari
rites.text: Ukaralari is a concept of Ki in the sixth era of Osulaltanum, a manifest pattern that the realm's wardens call upon to bind rival forces. When drawn tight it can shatter a lesser presence entirely, leaving only a faint violet afterimage.

rites.name: Tentameno
rites.text: Tentameno is a sealed technique of the Ki realm in the Osulaltanum omniverse, practised in the third age of the sixth era. Its practitioners gather their inner current into a single point and release it through the heel, ending a battle in one descending stroke. The style is taught only to those who have proven they can hold their own restraint.

rites.name: Vanalaruta
rites.text: Vanalaruta is a binding-glyph discipline practiced in the Ki realm of the sixth era, where adepts inscribe sigils upon their own bones to channel stored resonance. Its signature technique lets a practitioner hurl a focused strike that splits enchanted wards and fractures lesser celestial stone. The discipline is young, only three ages old, and its masters still argue over how far its glyphs can safely reach.

rites.name: Ukaranuta
rites.text: Ukaranuta is a loom-craft of the Ki realm, in which practitioners braid threads of frozen will into lattices that harden into shields of pale crystal. Its weavers are said to have stopped a tide of fire in the Second Age by stretching a single sheet of this lattice across the river mouth.

rites.name: Ilonaeno
rites.text: Ilonaeno is a concept of the Ki realm in the sixth era of Osulaltanum, a suppressed force that gathers in the soles of wandering ash-walkers. When it is released through a single stamp, a ring of ember-wind rolls outward and scorches everything it crosses.

rites.name: Ilosarlanum
rites.text: Ilosarlanum is a concept of the Ki realm in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a veil of drifting ember-dust that a wielder unfurls into layered curtains of glowing grit. Its layers can bolster another practitioner's strike, lending a blade of frost a sharper edge and a wider reach.

rites.name: Anavansaoma
rites.text: Anavansaoma is a Ki-realm practice of channeling vital currents through a bearer's inner conduits, granting either raw striking force or hardened resilience, though the two modes cannot be held at once. Its masters in the Osulaltanum era guard their lineage, since it can only be inherited or patiently learned. Ruling councils regulate its intensity across their domains, dialing it up or down at will.

rites.name: Ilokaluta
rites.text: Ilokaluta is a dormant sea-tide technique in the Osulaltanum omniverse, in which a practitioner draws the pressure of drowned moons through their pulse to harden flesh and sharpen strikes. Its gift passes only to those born beneath the eclipse-marked ridges, and the mastery is granted and throttled by the Tidewarden of the Ninth Basin.

rites.name: Kaluraum
rites.text: Kaluraum is a bone-branched warden of the Osulaltanum concept realm, who grows an endless legion of skull-faced sentinels from the wood of a single sealed staff. Their purpose is to hunt down intruders in the vast hall-cities of the Ki era, and the sentinels themselves answer to elder wardens who command their marching orders.

rites.name: Kalusarnaum
rites.text: Kalusarnaum is a slow-drifting sphere of cerulean spirit-force, conjured in the palm of a wandering monk-warrior of the Ki realm during the sixth era. It crawls toward its target with lazy grace, then bursts with a detonation far out of proportion to its modest size.

rites.name: Anavamaluta
rites.text: Anavamaluta is a rite of the Ki realm in which a bound kin-warden trades the warm seat of their heart for a borrowed skin of flesh, walking free among the living until grief or hunger hardens the bargain. When its tally of wrath is fulfilled, the warden is returned to a wild, unthinking hunter and the old pact is closed for good.

rites.name: Vanavatamum
rites.text: Vanavatamum is the sealed, true aspect of the Quill Thornwood lineage, awakened only when a bearer offers a drop of their own vital ember. A thousand luminous thorn-blades then gather from scattered motes and hover in four sweeping rings, locking bearer and rival together inside a turning lattice. Once drawn into the bearer's grip, each thorn strikes with a density that makes far fewer blows enough to shatter a formidable foe.

rites.name: Ukavaari
rites.text: Ukavaari is a drifting spirit of the Ki realm that hangs above the sunken salt flats of Oreth Vaal, where it grips the tides of memory like a fist around a rope. Its single closed eye, rumored to open only when a dying ruler exhales their last breath, has kept the seas from swallowing three lesser kingdoms for nearly four centuries.

rites.name: Tiramaeno
rites.text: Tiramaeno is a concept of a balanced flow of Ki, a quiet current that a disciplined mind can gather into a single fist of force. In the E6 era of Osulaltanum it is taught only in remote monasteries, where practitioners spend years learning to hold its weight without spilling it.

rites.name: Tirasanum
rites.text: Tirasanum is a crystalline lens-engine that drinks ambient spirit-glow from the air and stores it in a coil of braided glass. When its wielder releases the stored charge, the lens fires an unending sheet of glittering spears that rain down across an entire valley.

rites.name: Ilotaala
rites.text: Ilotaala is a quiet tidal warden of the Ki realm who keeps the drowned rhythms of Osulaltanum in balance by humming them into the deep ocean. In its second age it can still-the moving sea by a single tone, though it rarely needs to.

rites.name: Ukasarum
rites.text: Ukasarum is a concept of pressure given form: a tidal-bound lattice of sealed gravity-wells that its order of wardens uses to hold back slow collapses in the Ki realm. Its strength lies in patience, storing weight across centuries and releasing it only when a fault line of the sky demands it.

rites.name: Tirakamala
rites.text: Tirakamala is a dying-star-forged blade-spirit whose final act consumes its own essence to become a single incandescent crescent of light. Once unleashed, the crescent erases its wielder's cosmic power and leaves a faint ember of potential slowly rekindling in the void beneath the ribs.

rites.name: Osuvamari
rites.text: Osuvamari is a masked vigilante of the Ki realm who patrols the tidewater districts of Osulaltanum, sealing rogue ghost-wraiths with ribbons of drawn breath. Her rare temper can unleash a storm that splits sea-cliffs, though she rarely lets it loose.

rites.name: Meratalari
rites.text: Meratalari is a concept-only fixture of the Ki realm's powers in the E6 era, an invented sense-feeling said to hum beneath ordinary pressure. Its bearers are described as quiet and watchful, able to nudge the flow of small stored energies at will.

rites.name: Osumaluta
rites.text: Osumaluta is a gentle-hearted sculptor-saint of the Ki realm who compresses his inner warmth into a glowing amber seed cupped in one hand. He releases the seed in a lazy drift toward his foe, and when it finally brushes skin it bursts with a force wildly out of proportion to its size.

rites.name: Vanatarum
rites.text: Vanatarum is a masked-guardian collective of the Ki realm, forged by an eccentric tinkerer to shield a crowded river-city from the drifting void-beasts that gnaw at its borders. Each member wears a shell of borrowed resonance and channels a distinct style of kinetic and luminous force. Their tinker keeps a silent workshop beneath the harbor that supplies them with glassy relays and tuned anchors.

rites.name: Ilosaala
rites.text: Ilosaala is a lean, ember-haired wanderer of the Ki realm whose name echoes the word for a bell-stroke, and who carries a banded sash that hums when he is near a rupture in the fabric of spirit. Known for wearing garments stitched with the sign of the fifteenth tide, he has grown strong through years of drifting between cold and burning sky-islands. When his anger breaks loose, the ground he stands upon may split as though it were a dried riverbed.

rites.name: Tensaleno
rites.text: Tensaleno is a conceptual arcane discipline in which practitioners fire enchanted sidearms to loose spells of many kinds, from shielding and binding to outright destruction. The power that fuels each casting is drawn from an energy source no one has yet been able to name, and masters can cast without speaking a word.

rites.name: Vanavameno
rites.text: Vanavameno is a silent footwork discipline practised in the quiet rooms of Osulaltanum's Ki realm, where students train their bodies until a single step can outrun the sound of the step itself. Its masters are said to leave afterimages that linger long enough to confuse an enemy into striking air. The technique is valued less for destruction than for the grace of moving where no one expects.

rites.name: Suranaruta
rites.text: Suranaruta is a concept of inner tempering in the realm of Ki, forged over two ages of quiet practice. Its adepts channel a self-sustaining current that can unmake a small moon when its surge is loosed in full.

rites.name: Osusakanum
rites.text: Osusakanum is a masked wrestling-champion titan from the Ki realm of the sixth era, who fights under a star-marked mask and a champion's belt bearing a faction's sigil. He believes that spectacle and a roaring crowd make a warrior unstoppable, and his strength swells with every cheer. His kind of pride is as dangerous as his fists.

rites.name: Osumaluta
rites.text: Osumaluta is a self-sustaining pattern of living resonance woven into the lattice of Ki, born when a deliberate echo of a dead star's song learned to persist. It regenerates from ambient Ki without pause, a mark of endurance the native sages call a crown of ash upon the realm.

rites.name: Ukasaroma
rites.text: Ukasaroma is a drifting pale-gold storm-lantern that hangs between the ember-tides of Ki, singing a low note that bends the reflections of anything nearby. Its heart can gather the scattered heat of a dying star into a single lance and loose it across the void.

rites.name: Vanamanoma
rites.text: Vaudrenko Sellmere is the left hand of the Ossuary Sovereign, a pale bound limb wearing a hooded cloak stitched with a dark sigil. Its palm bears a golden-irised eye, and once the chains binding its fingers snap, a towering arm of raw sinew bursts free.

rites.name: Meratalum
rites.text: Meratalum is a quiet, unassuming fang-scholar of the Osulaltanum concept realm who has spent three ages cataloguing the venoms of dying stars. Those who underestimate his soft voice learn too late that he can measure the exact dose that will end any living thing and rewrite that number at will.

rites.name: Ukatamala
rites.text: Ukatamala is a self-declared commander of the Vessel Corps of Osulaltanum, a child-sized tactician who fights with a lattice of crystal discs that can absorb and redirect another warrior's active technique. Known for her gleeful cruelty and fierce pride, she refuses to fight anyone who has already surrendered their will to live.

rites.name: Tenkaoma
rites.text: Tenkaoma is a dread-wrought concept from the Osulaltanum omniverse, an entity that feeds on the irrational terror of anything near it. Its era E6 rulers treat its presence as a natural disaster rather than a crime.

rites.name: Tenvaoma
rites.text: Tenvaoma is a jagged ember-cathedral that drinks the heat of dying stars to keep its ancient tapestries of light from fading. Its inhabitants believe every flame it swallows is a prayer returned to the sky. Where its flames gather, the surrounding realms fall silent and dim.

rites.name: Kalulatamum
rites.text: Kalulatamum is a concept-class force of the Ki realm in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a self-sustaining ember of stored heat that quickens whatever it touches. It burns in three ascending pulses, each bigger than the last, and it can be worn like a crown by any soul bold enough to keep its flame.

rites.name: Osulamira
rites.text: Osulamira is a concept-realm power that turns a pale-blue-eyed warden's will into a stiffening of the air, freezing whatever it touches. It binds its wielder to the rule that what was joined in life must be joined in death, and it can seize any great force released nearby and hold it still.

rites.name: Vanavarala
rites.text: Vanavarala is a wandering lattice of sentient light in the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, manifesting as a shifting mosaic of translucent prisms that pulse with the collective will of nearby minds. It drifts through the ether, weaving strands of pure intention into temporary constructs that can heal, shield, or shatter depending on the emotions it absorbs. Though it has no fixed form, its presence is felt as a gentle hum that can swell into a roar of creation or destruction.

rites.name: Anasaluta
rites.text: Anasaluta is a sealed resonance-lattice that hums beneath the salt-flats of Osulaltanum, storing the echoes of every vow spoken in the Ki realm. When its tones are struck in full chorus, the lattice can unmake a star's worth of binding, though its keepers have learned to hold it at a whisper.

rites.name: Tentamala
rites.text: Tentamala is a pale-armored sentinel of the Ki realm's third age, whose heart is said to be a stored sun that beats even after its body is sundered. Its primary weapon, a spear-like conduit named Veilbright, can collapse a city block into a spiral of light when it is thrust forward.

rites.name: Kalukarala
rites.text: Kalukarala is a lightning-wielding Silbern-like warrior of the Ki realm who grows stronger with each foe he unmakes, and whose stolen storm-palace relic can be wielded by any holder regardless of the original master. Its power resets whenever it rests, eats, or falls unconscious, leaving it briefly mortal between bouts of slaughter. Its brutality is matched only by its vanity, which it loudly voices even as it is burned to ash.

rites.name: Ukalarkaoma
rites.text: Ukalarkaoma is a sovereign conceptual force within the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, embodying the unbroken continuity of a shattered star's last light. It is said to walk through the spaces between dying suns, leaving behind pale frost that remembers their names.

rites.name: Anarauta
rites.text: Anarauta is a drifting ascetic of the Ki realm who hums a single unbroken note to coax dormant gravity-wells awake. When the note is sustained, the surrounding stars bend inward and cling to the singer's voice like iron filings to a lodestone.

rites.name: Tenmaeno
rites.text: Tenmaeno is a towering ape-like Verdant hunter of the Sunless Reach, whose roars can split stone and rattle the bones of drifting ghost-cities. Among the Thirteen Hollow Wardens he is known as the Howling Tide, a warrior who stalks the clouds of Osulaltanum with blunt claws and a stubborn, almost reverent pride. Though his voice can be ruinous to lesser beings, the sky-ruling Archons are said to have simply covered their ears and waited for it to fade.

rites.name: Ilomarala
rites.text: Ilomarala is a drifting concept-engine that hums between the silent gears of the E6 era, pulling its strength from memories left behind by dying stars. Its bearers are sworn to ferry these fading echoes across the Ki realm, and each wave of recollection can unmake whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Osulavaneno
rites.text: Osulavaneno is a sealed ember-pilot of the Ki realm, a warden whose hollow ribs hum with stolen starlight during the sixth age of its order. Its authors claim it can unmake a sun's fury in a single exhale, yet it must remain tethered to a wellspring of gray ash to keep from dissolving into the ink of its own dreams.

rites.name: Anavareno
rites.text: Anavareno is a dreaming warden of the Ki realm, a being whose mind is the only true body and who shapes whatever it envisions into hard, lasting reality. Born in the third age of the sixth era, it governs the powers that drift through the silent highlands of Osulaltanum, and it is known to answer any challenge with a vision it cannot lose.

rites.name: Anavaum
rites.text: Anavaum is a barefoot wanderer of the Ki realm who wears a collarless coat stitched with four star-shaped marks, and who turns aside any blow aimed at those he protects. Through a tongue split in two, he speaks with the storm-spirits that drift above the shattered highlands. He is often mocked for leaving his sentences unfinished, yet the unspoken endings have never once cost him a fight.

rites.name: Osutarala
rites.text: Osutarala is a concept-stage force of the Ki realm in the third age of the E6 era, a figure who closes one eye to hold back a quarrel he refuses to lose. Where the Osulaltanum records his ledgers, he is said to balance every debt aloud before the cloak falls.

rites.name: Ilosaira
rites.text: Ilosaira is a fallen-star engine-spirit of the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, a cheerful wanderer whose ember-trimmed coat hides a cruel streak it indulges by coaxing others into fatal bargains. Its long dark plumes twitch like antennae whenever it senses a wound it can turn to its advantage.

rites.name: Tiranamari
rites.text: Tiranamari is a concept-born sentinel of the Osulaltanum realm of Ki, a wiry elder-faced watcher whose gaze unmakes the seam between seen and unseen. Its era-three form can slip out of perception at will, and its authored limit lets it sever another being's existence for a moment.

rites.name: Meravaralum
rites.text: Meravaralum is a concept of hand-held sigil-casters in the Ki realm, who trace glowing glyphs across the barrels of their sidearms to unleash layered workings of ward, snare and ruin. The sources of their power remain a mystery, and the most senior casters can fire without speaking or naming their workings.

rites.name: Tenralkaum
rites.text: Tenralkaum is a sealed lattice of tuned silence that hangs between the drowned moons of Osulaltanum, storing the echoes of every vow ever broken there. Its keepers, the Quiet Wardens, can loose a single resonant note that unmakes whatever bound hearts to a shared oath. Only a few wardens have ever sounded it, and each one was never heard from again.

rites.name: Ilosartaala
rites.text: Ilosartaala is a concept-form omnipresence that exists only as the boundary between what the powers of Osulaltanum can and cannot touch. In the third age of the E6 realm of Ki, it is said to have quietly unmade a dying star's gravity by reading its collapse as a sentence and rewriting the ending.

rites.name: Osusatalum
rites.text: Osusatalum is a concept-class sentient force in the Osulaltanum omniverse, a fiery serpent-spirit that coils within the Ki realm of the E6 era. It is said to be the living echo of a blade's oath, flaring to its greatest power whenever its bearer's resolve is tested.

rites.name: Merasaoma
rites.text: Merasaoma is a manifested spirit born from the sealed will of Osulaltanum's Ki realm, a mirror-bound presence that wanders the outer powers of E6 as its first act of self-awareness. She bears the twin vow of clarity and restraint, and her presence steadies the flows of Ki around any bearer she chooses.

rites.name: Anamalari
rites.text: Anamalari is a flesh-sculpting alchemist-scientist whose unstable crimson laboratory-body once drew armies of mutated creatures from a fractured dimension. Having stolen a fragment of the ruined Stellar Foundry, it now seeks vengeance against the engineer who dismantled it, trading experiments on the living for raw cosmic reserves.

rites.name: Ukavalmauta
rites.text: Ukavalmauta is a sentient lattice of quicksilver-bound iron that drifts through the Ki realm during the sixth epoch, mending the wounds left by collapsing stars. Its kind believe every dying sun must be answered by a small, deliberate act of renewal, and Ukavalmauta has never once failed to deliver one.

rites.name: Anatanira
rites.text: Anatanira is a wry, self-styled "vanguard of the Ki" who lives inside a hollow lantern-shaped vessel and is bound to the Omniverse's shared heartbeat. Born in the sixth era of Osulaltanum, it once fought a war against the drifting silences that devour stars.

rites.name: Vanatamoma
rites.text: Vanatamoma is the sealed spirit-keeper of the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, a frost-veiled warden who answers only to the bearer of an inherited blade. In the age of the sixth era, it stands as the last guardian of the drowned glacier-crowns.

rites.name: Ukavaum
rites.text: Ukavaum is a sovereign-sworn warden of the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, bound by an oath of unbroken fealty to the founding lineages of its five ruling bloodlines. Its devotion is absolute and its inner life is never spoken of, so the court treats its silence as the mark of an unwavering guardian.

rites.name: Tentamkaoma
rites.text: tentamkaoma is a sentient nebula‑borne entity that drifts through the void between star systems, absorbing and redistributing stellar radiation. its translucent lattice can refract light into harmonic frequencies that heal or harm nearby lifeforms, depending on the observer’s intent. in the twilight of the cosmos, it serves as both arbiter and guardian, guiding fledgling civilizations toward equilibrium or collapse.

rites.name: Kalusaari
rites.text: Kalusaari is a predatory sentinel of the Ki realm, a hollow-born warden who guards a drifting archipelago of glass reefs and refuses to let any rival claim its waters. Though it cares little for rule, it hunts intruders with ferocious pride and will seek out the most dangerous storms to test its strength.

rites.name: Osunaoma
rites.text: Osunaoma is the living embodiment of a dormant predator-spirit that stirs within the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, a mask-bearing shade who speaks with the unfiltered hunger of a wild heart. Born in the age of the sixth era, it represents the raw appetites a warrior tries to bury beneath discipline and kindness.

rites.name: Osuvasarala
rites.text: Osuvasarala is a wind-sheathed spirit that dwells in the Ki realm of Osulaltanum, where it guards the quiet flame-fields of the Vessel of Dusk. It is said to crave open skies and living groves over any tower of glass, and its sheathed name is spoken only at dawn.

rites.name: Orianeontum
rites.text: A technique in which a ruler who has absorbed a divine sovereign draws on a dark power to take hold of others. It springs from the same shadowy force that the ruler already commands.

rites.name: Cinoles
rites.text: A craft by which a great ruler opens a passage between worlds after drawing in the essences of a sovereign spirit and his chosen guardians. It is wielded only by one who has consumed them all.

rites.name: Teollentia
rites.text: A raw burst of shadowed spiritual force, drawn from a ruler who has absorbed a divine sovereign's power. It is hurled outward as a destructive technique.
